queries:
SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM orderexecutions e
JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.orderbase
SELECT exectune,
       COUNT(fillcount) AS execution_count,
       100.0 * COUNT(fillcount) / (SELECT COUNT(fillcount) FROM orderexecutions) AS share_pct
FROM orderexecutions
GROUP BY exectune;
SELECT o.orderbase AS channel,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count,
       100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.recordvault) FROM orders o2 JOIN orderexecutions e2 ON e2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS share_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.orderbase
ORDER BY order_count DESC;
